comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with affiliated mortgage and title services.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Large production homebuilder selling to individual buyers, with mortgage and title arms; rental and lot sales are minor differences.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder of single-family homes and townhomes on optioned lots, with affiliated mortgage and title services.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Sells finished lots to homebuilders, mainly D.R. Horton; it is a B2B land developer, not a homebuilder.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes to individual buyers with mortgage and title services; its land development is mostly for its own use.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling to first-time and move-up buyers using subcontractors, with affiliated mortgage and title services.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Mainly life insurance, funeral products and title insurance, with a mortgage unit; it does not build homes.
